kinds.about: Texture packs: one folder per disc id (e.g. ULUS10041) holding textures.ini with the pack's files, or textures.zip, as PPSSPP's PSP/TEXTURES/<disc id>.
kinds.doc: PPSSPP v1.20.4 reads PSP/TEXTURES/<disc id> in its memory stick, ${state_root}/config/ppsspp, when it is a folder (TextureReplacer.cpp:78-79), through stat (DirListing.cpp:134-144), preferring textures.zip, else the folder and its textures.ini (:132-150); it writes new/ there only with SaveNewTextures (:83-87), which stays False. ReplaceTextures is on only while a pack is installed (Config.cpp:762-763).

mods.doc: Dormant until a pack is placed: the library is <paths.mods>/ppsspp/textures/<disc id>, one link per game folder into the memory stick's PSP/TEXTURES.

render_scale.doc: [Graphics] InternalResolution is PPSSPP's render scale (1 is 480x272, 0 the window's own size), read at boot. PPSSPP draws the picture letterboxed into its window, so the renderer cuts it at the declared native 480x272.

doc.launch: The bundled source-built SDL frontend receives --fullscreen and exactly one positional ROM appended by the launcher. No host executable, Flatpak, libretro core, or prebuilt binary is permitted.
doc.state: PPSSPP maps $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ppsspp to isolated Semu state. Generated settings live in PSP/SYSTEM, game saves in PSP/SAVEDATA, save states in PSP/PPSSPP_STATE, and cache/screenshots remain below the same isolated root.
doc.input: Pad zero is PPSSPP's SDL GameController lane for the Steam Virtual Gamepad. PSP controls are explicit, Semu keymap actions compile to PPSSPP chords, and the target process-group watcher owns immediate physical Start+Select termination.
doc.rendering: The managed profile pins OpenGL. libsemupreload (render_preload) composes Semu's bezel and shader at the SDL/EGL swap: it reads the emulator's back buffer and writes the composed frame back before the real swap.
doc.content: What PPSSPP fa50bb19 boots (Core/Loaders.cpp:110 disc images, 227-228 executables, 264 .pbp) and a .zip holding an ISO (269, 294-307). A .7z is identified only to be refused.

save_states.doc: PPSSPP cycles SaveStateSlotCount slots (5, pinned in ppsspp.ini) and wraps both ways, showing slot + 1 (Core/SaveState.cpp:353-359, 822 at fa50bb1); ppsspp.ini starts each launch on slot 0.

menu.doc: Seen 2026-10-03 in the podman VM (tests/integration/menu-pause.sh, Burnout Legends through libsemupreload on llvmpipe): Ctrl+P (Pause (no menu)) froze the attract mode, and a menu record written while paused showed at once over the frozen frame, so PPSSPP keeps presenting while paused and the menu pauses it.
